comment: Device-level MCP definitions for AutoClaw2 (zwork) - docs/AUTOCLAW2_SYNC_SPEC.md.
Definitions ONLY: no credentials, no tokens, no env values (names via envKeys at most).
Seeded 2026-11-04 from the ZCode Primary working set (the same servers the central
registry tools/mcp/master-mcp.json carries) - review and trim here freely; per-clone
'enabled' toggles survive every sync: toggle servers off in the app's UI and the sync
will not re-enable them. Run GHOST.bat > AutoClaw2 > [8] Import MCPs to clones
(or tools\sync_autoclaw2_mcp.ps1); '-From Primary' reads the Primary profile instead.
Everything in '_samples' is documentation and is ignored by the loader.

servers.name: Upstash
servers.credentialHint: the remote endpoint handles its own OAuth per app

servers.name: Sentry
servers.credentialHint: SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN header is configured per app - sign in once per clone

servers.name: GitHub (Copilot MCP)
servers.credentialHint: Authorization header is per account - sign in once per clone in the app
